newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Henkel Hungary unit to quadruple exports.
newsitem.headline: Henkel Hungary unit to quadruple exports.

text.p: The Hungarian unit of Germany's chemicals and consumer products group Henkel said on Wednesday that it was likely to double its exports both in 1996 and 1997.

Istvan Fekete, Managing Director of Henkel Hungary Kft was quoted by the MTI news agency as saying that exports were seen reaching 2.6 billion forints in 1996, up from 1.3 billion in 1995, and were likely to double again in 1997.
Henkel, which invested more than three billion forints in its operations in Hungary, produces detergents, cleaning liquids and adhesives in the country. @
Henkel Hungary expects to increase its sales to 13.4 billion forints this year from 11.2 billion forints in 1995.
Henkel has a share of some 40 percent on Hungary's household cleaner market, and a 60 percent market share in selling adhesives.
